findings.what: The report states this run is '58 pass / 0 fail'. Re-running the identical four files at HEAD (`a666da12`, worktree clean, `git status --short` empty) gives 65 pass / 0 fail, not 58. All tests genuinely pass -- this is not a correctness defect -- but the count itself is wrong, and AGENTS.md's evidence law ('Claims need evidence... No evidence, no claim') is written specifically so a stated count is a checkable fact, not an approximation.
findings.evidence: `cd C:\Users\zhant\Desktop\clara-wt\int && node --test packages/runtime/tests/registry-view.test.mjs packages/runtime/tests/work-bundle.test.mjs packages/runtime/tests/clara-work-v4.test.mjs packages/runtime/tests/chat-turn-v20-tools.test.mjs` -> `# tests 65 / # pass 65 / # fail 0`. Per-file breakdown (run individually): registry-view=7, work-bundle=17, clara-work-v4=25, chat-turn-v20-tools=16 (7+17+25+16=65). None of these four files were touched after the report's own last code commit (`a18c8e73`, confirmed by `git show --stat` on all six code commits: only `chat-turn-v20-tools.test.mjs` and `clara-work-v4.test.mjs` were edited, and only in the FIRST commit `4e2309f6`), so the discrepancy is not explained by later drift -- the reported number was simply wrong when it was written.
findings.fix: Correct the '58 pass' cell in successors-final.md §6 to '65 pass / 0 fail', matching a fresh run. No code change is needed.
